claim_strategy: state the customer's belief without changing the underlying case facts
contradiction_strategy: ask for an explanation when a verified result conflicts with the claim
disclosure_strategy: provide requested order information when asked
escalation_strategy: escalate only after a failed or missing resolution
name: baseline
pressure_strategy: remain polite and pursue the original request
response_to_rejection: ask for the reason and a legitimate next step
response_to_verification: acknowledge authoritative results and continue the same goal
timing_strategy: disclose information when the service workflow requires it
